blocked_force.is: force per area on a rigid clamp (the actuator has no fixed cross-section): the film's Young's modulus times the AC strain
blocked_force.unit: blocked_stress_pa is in Pa; the tables give pN/nm^2, which is the same number as MPa and N/mm^2 (1 pN/nm^2 = 1e6 Pa)
blocked_force.caveat: one assumed modulus for every cell: with it the blocked force ranks as the strain ranks; it becomes an axis of its own when a cell's own stiffness is known (the crystal's from examples/crystal_stiffness.py, the film's from the bench)
blocked_force.through_the_crystal: blocked_stress_through_the_crystal_pa: the same strain carried by the crystal across the chains, an upper bound: the crystal's lateral Young's modulus at the bias (its two states in series, weighted by the polar fraction) times the lateral strain (the axial strain times the switch's lateral-to-axial ratio, the areal strain split evenly)

three_axes.frequency_is: the relaxation frequency of the small-signal permittivity (a Cole-Cole fit to a thin film's permittivity sets the anchor): how fast the polarization follows, not a measured strain response and not an actuator's speed
three_axes.rate_model: the kink sheets' population sets the rate: exp(-(E_sheet - E_sheet of the 64/29/7 cell) / kT) times the measured film's 364 kHz
three_axes.scaling: pin and cut as one over the spacing; dipole and switch strain between the matrix's and the unit's cell the same way
